system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Hebrew clans in plain woven wool walking across the dry sea floor between two towering walls of water","action":"Families and herders advance in a steady line through the middle of the sea on dry ground, children and bundles carried, eyes forward","setting":"Sea of Reeds at night, a wide dry channel of sea floor with water standing up in walls on both sides, hill country shore visible beyond","secondaryElements":"Pillar of cloud glowing with fire above the camp, Moses at the front of the procession with outstretched hand, strong east wind stirring the air, wet glistening sea floor","mood":"Awed, solemn wonder and sacred dread mingled with tense hope","timeOfDay":"Deep night, with the first hint of pale light beginning at the far edge of the sky","composition":"Wide shot from low on the dry sea floor looking forward, water walls rising on left and right framing the procession receding into the distance"}
